name: Product Price Enquiry & Quote Request Contact Form for WooCommerce
author: Atakan Au

sections.description:
The Product Price Enquiry & Quote Request Contact Form for WooCommerce plugin is a powerful tool for WooCommerce store owners who want to offer a more personalized shopping experience. This plugin allows you to replace the default “Add to Cart” button with a link to a Contact Form 7 inquiry form for specific products. Ideal for businesses selling high-value, custom, or complex products, it enables customers to request more information or customized quotes from the product page.

Key features include:
– Flexible Configuration: Enable the inquiry form for individual products via a simple checkbox in the General tab. Product variations support is available in the PRO version.
– Seamless Integration: Works with Contact Form 7 to link to a designated inquiry form page, with automatic population of product data (name, ID).
– WPML Compatibility: Supports multilingual stores with WPML integration for translated inquiry form pages (PRO).
– Customizable Styling: Add custom CSS classes to inquiry buttons directly from the settings page.
– Admin-Friendly: Dedicated settings page under Settings > Cart Inquiry Form to manage global options.

The plugin is lightweight, secure, and optimized for performance, ensuring a smooth user experience for both store owners and customers.

Visit to blog page for more information and documentation: Product Price Enquiry & Quote Request Contact Form for WooCommerce

Benefits of Using Product Price Enquiry & Quote Request Contact Form for WooCommerce

  • Enhanced Customer Engagement: Allow customers to inquire about products directly, fostering trust and communication.
  • Increased Flexibility: Perfect for businesses offering custom or high-value products where direct purchases may not be suitable.
  • Seamless Integration: Works effortlessly with Contact Form 7 and supports WPML for multilingual stores (PRO version).
  • Time-Saving: Simplifies the process of setting up inquiry forms with minimal configuration.
  • Improved Conversion Rates: Encourages hesitant buyers to reach out, potentially increasing sales for complex products.

Store owners choose this plugin for its ease of use, robust integration with WooCommerce, and ability to create a tailored shopping experience that meets their customers’ needs.

Integration with Contact Form 7

To automatically capture product information in your inquiry emails, add the following fields to your Contact Form 7 form:

  • [text* product_name readonly] — Displays the product name (read-only).
  • [hidden product_id] — Captures the internal WordPress product ID.
  • [hidden product_sku] — Captures the product SKU (PRO version only).
  • [hidden form_subject] — Captures the form subject (PRO version only).

The plugin uses JavaScript to dynamically populate these fields when a customer arrives from a product page.

Support

Support requests, bug reports, feedback, and feature requests can be submitted via the support forum or the plugin’s blog page.

If you find the plugin useful, please consider leaving a 5-star review. You can also support my work with a donation.

Collaboration

I am a freelance developer available for custom development, integrations, and technical consulting. If you have a project related to this plugin, feel free to get in touch.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/product-price-enquiry-quote-request-contact-form directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. The plugin will check for WooCommerce and Contact Form 7 dependencies (Requires WP 6.5+ for native dependency handling).
  4. Go to Settings > Cart Inquiry Form to select your inquiry page and configure button styles.
  5. Edit a product, enable the “Inquiry Form” option under the General tab, and save.
sections.faq:
How do I enable the inquiry form for a product?

Edit the product, go to the “General” tab, check the “Enable Inquiry Form” box, and save.

Which page should I select for the inquiry form?

Choose a page containing a Contact Form 7 shortcode in the plugin settings under Settings > Cart Inquiry Form.

Can I customize the inquiry button?

Yes, add a custom CSS class in the plugin settings to style the button.

Does it support product variations?

No, free version does not support product variations. But, you can enable the inquiry form for variable products with the pro version. If you want to enable the inquiry form for individual variations, please check out the pro version.

Does it support block theme?

Yes, but except removing add to cart button. You can remove add to cart button with the pro version.
